opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January. You will be notified by the end of January regarding the outcome of your application.
Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must have BES membership. Groups must have a diverse mix of members at different career stages, a diversity of institutions and have international participation.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 10 March. You will be notified in late May regarding the outcome of your application.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 10 March.

amount.raw: £3,500 in year 1 and £500 per year for the next five years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Long-term research grants are awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Supporting the launch of new long-term studies by funding up to £500 per year for a decade of data collection.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May. You will be notified by the end of May regarding the outcome of your application.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Projects should be a maximum of 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Improving the education of future generations of ecologists by providing up to £5k towards evidence-based learning.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Placements can be full-time or part-time, and can be up to 12 months long.
opportunities.summary: Promoting interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements in different disciplines and sectors.

opportunities.title: Small research grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 10 March. You will be notified in late May regarding the outcome of your application.
Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Projects should be a maximum of 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January. You will be notified by the end of January regarding the outcome of your application.
Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May. You will be notified by the end of May regarding the outcome of your application.
Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January.

amount.raw: A maximum of £500 for events in person

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member. Must be a PhD student or postgraduate researcher. Must work or study at a university or research institution. Must give a presentation if attending a meeting.
opportunities.summary: Helping PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses, or the travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member. Must be a citizen of and based in the Global South. Must be travelling from and returning to the country you are based in the Global South. Must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend the BES Annual Meeting 2026 for researchers based in Global South countries.
